Vendored Prawitz support modules
===============================

Source: https://github.com/Jiyuan-Tan/CausalSmith
Commit: a7085d88d2e4b30003db7097ca374f4718da0f01
License: Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE); original upstream NOTICE retained.

This directory contains the original three upstream source files for provenance,
stored with a .txt suffix so that they are not compiled. Their upstream paths are
Causalean/Stat/CLT/BerryEsseen/{PrawitzKernel,PrawitzSignIntegrability,TriangularCosineIntegral}.lean.
The compiled local ports are in lean/KellerKlein/Vendor/. Only those three ports are
included in this project's Lean proof. The original NOTICE describes the larger
upstream project and additional dependencies that are not vendored here.

Port modifications for Lean 4.19 / pinned Mathlib:
- Removed newer module/public syntax and adapted imports to local modules.
- Added local sinc and interval-endpoint compatibility lemmas.
- Replaced newer tactic spellings (including convert!) and supplied explicit
  ring-normalization steps where API or tactic behavior differs.
- Retained the underlying mathematical statements and proofs.

Related conceptual source:
https://github.com/CoolRmal/BerryEsseen
Commit: bfb22608ad18b4fa9fda8dd9a1ed2c2b6fbc29e7
The recurrence approach to Prawitz's majorant informed the independently written
PrawitzRecurrence/PrawitzOscillation/PrawitzLimit/PrawitzMajorant modules.
No source code was copied from that repository; no license was located there.
The Prawitz inequality itself is established prior mathematics, not claimed as
an original theorem of the present research.
